findings.title: Invalid ERB closing statement prevents rendering existing discussions
findings.body: The template closes its conditional with `end if` without a condition after `if`. This is invalid Ruby syntax, so compiling the ERB raises a SyntaxError whenever the controller renders an existing embedded topic. Replace it with `end` and add a controller test that actually renders the view.

findings.title: Feed imports persist unsanitized HTML as cooked posts
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import passes externally supplied contents through Nokogiri parsing and then stores them using raw_html cooking, which returns the HTML unchanged. Nokogiri::HTML.fragment does not sanitize scripts, event handlers, or javascript URLs. PollFeed calls this method directly with feed content, so malicious feed HTML becomes stored XSS on the forum and in the embed view. Sanitize imported HTML with an explicit safe tag, attribute, and URL-scheme policy before storing it; the appended source URL also needs proper HTML escaping.

findings.title: Redirects bypass the remote retrieval host restriction
findings.body: TopicRetriever checks only the host of the initial embed URL, then import_remote fetches it with open-uri, which follows HTTP redirects. An endpoint on the configured embedding host can therefore redirect the worker to an internal HTTP service or another unapproved host, and the fetched content can be published as a topic. Validate each redirect destination and reject private/internal addresses before fetching, rather than relying solely on the initial URI host check.

findings.title: Relative and protocol-relative article URLs are resolved incorrectly
findings.body: absolutize_urls only handles values starting with `/` and treats all of them as paths on the article host. Consequently `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg` becomes `http://article-host/cdn.example.com/image.jpg`, while document-relative values such as `images/image.jpg` remain relative to the Discourse page instead of the source article. Both links and images in imported articles can therefore break or point to the wrong site. Resolve href and src values against the full source URI using URI joining, preserving protocol-relative hosts.

findings.title: RSS items without a content element abort feed polling
findings.body: The poller unconditionally calls scrub on i.content. RSS feeds commonly supply article text in description rather than content:encoded, leaving content nil; such an item raises NoMethodError and aborts the entire polling job before subsequent items are imported. Select the appropriate content/description field with a nil-safe fallback and test polling an actual RSS feed with description-only items.
